brief:
**BLUF:** Quiet Sunday across Tazewell County, VA, and Mercer County, WV, with no active NWS alerts or major incidents reported in the last 24 hours. West Virginia State Police continue seeking a missing 26-year-old man last associated with the Athens/Concord University area in Mercer County. Community events continue in Bluefield, including a train show and a Thanksgiving dinner.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/west-virginia-news/wv-state-police-looking-for-missing-man/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Core (Tazewell County VA / Mercer County WV):**  
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours from Tazewell County Sheriff’s Office, local police departments, or Virginia State Police Division IV.[[2]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/09/suspects-found-illegal-gathering-ginseng-cases/)

**Region:**  
West Virginia State Police are seeking Tavon Dandre Davis, 26, missing from the Athens area (Mercer County). He was last seen on or around November 8 wearing a brown jacket, blue shirt, and gray sweatpants; he may be driving a gold 2004 Cadillac sedan. A cellphone ping placed him near Concord University. Contact WVSP at 304-746-2100 with information. (Reported November 14.)[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/west-virginia-news/wv-state-police-looking-for-missing-man/)

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours in the core or region.

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
**Core:** No active NWS alerts. Bluefield/Tazewell area forecast: highs in the lower 40s with a chance of drizzle today; overnight lows in the upper 20s to lower 30s under mostly cloudy skies. Northwest winds 5-10 mph. No reported road closures on US-19, US-460, US-52, or I-77.[[3]](https://www.weatherbug.com/weather-forecast/10-day-weather/bluefield-wv-24701)

**Region:** No significant severe weather, interstate closures, or large incidents reported in the last 24 hours.

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours in the core or region. (Recent election results and school tax referendums from earlier in November are not developing today.)

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Core:**  
- Bluefield Train Show continues today (November 15) at Mercer Mall, 1-5 p.m. (admission $5; children 12 and under free).[[4]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/13/bluefield-train-show-returns-mercer-mall/)
- Friends and Family Thanksgiving Dinner hosted by Hesed International Ministries at 500 North Street, Bluefield, WV, starting at 11 a.m. (bring a dish).[[5]](https://allevents.in/bluefield/friends-and-family-thanksgiving-dinner/200031050498145)

**Region:** Nothing additional reported in the last 24 hours.

## WATCH -- NEXT 48 HOURS
- Ongoing search for missing man Tavon Dandre Davis (Mercer County).  
- Bluefield Train Show concludes today.  
- No scheduled major meetings or weather hazards noted.
